description: OMOP CDM v5.4 CONDITION_OCCURRENCE table — records of conditions, diagnoses, signs, symptoms, which are either observed, reported, or inferred. Conditions are typically coded using ICD-10, SNOMED CT, or similar vocabularies.

fields.label: Condition Occurrence ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for each condition occurrence event.

fields.label: Person ID
fields.description: A foreign key identifier to the Person who is experiencing the condition. The demographic details of that Person are stored in the PERSON table.

fields.label: Condition Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies for the condition. These are SNOMED-CT concepts.

fields.label: Condition Start Date
fields.description: The date when the instance of the Condition is recorded.

fields.label: Condition Start Datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the instance of the Condition is recorded.

fields.label: Condition End Date
fields.description: The date when the instance of the Condition is considered to have ended.

fields.label: Condition End Datetime
fields.description: The date and time when the instance of the Condition is considered to have ended.

fields.label: Condition Type Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the predefined Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the source data from which the condition was recorded.

fields.label: Condition Status Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key that refers to a Standard Concept identifier in the Standardized Vocabularies reflecting the point of care at which the Condition was diagnosed.

fields.label: Stop Reason
fields.description: The reason that the condition was no longer present, as indicated in the source data.

fields.label: Provider ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the Provider in the PROVIDER table who was responsible for capturing (diagnosing) the Condition.

fields.label: Visit Occurrence ID
fields.description: A foreign key to the visit in the VISIT_OCCURRENCE table during which the Condition was determined (diagnosed).

fields.label: Condition Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the condition as it appears in the source data. This code is mapped to a Standard Concept in the Standardized Vocabularies and the original code is stored here for reference.

fields.label: Condition Source Concept ID
fields.description: A foreign key to a Concept that refers to the code used in the source.

fields.label: Condition Status Source Value
fields.description: The source code for the condition status as it appears in the source data.
